## Execution tips

- Grasp opposing straight sides of the stamp's upper half, avoiding beveled edges and corners with the pads. Leave the lower stamping face clear for contact to reduce slipping or the gripper hitting the table first.
- Set the opening slightly wider than the selected grasp area. Before closing, confirm that the fingers are on opposite sides of the stamp rather than merely overlapping in the image without enclosing it effectively.
- Keep the stamp upright while approaching the mark, correct horizontal offset above it, then lower slowly and vertically to reduce positional shifts from pressing at an angle or dragging sideways.
- Let the stamp rest on the table before opening the gripper, and watch whether the fingers shift it away from the center of the mark during withdrawal.
